title: Lanthanide(III) complexation by the ligand 1,3,5-triamino-1,3,5-trideoxy-cis-inositol: an unusual thermodynamic behaviour across the rare-earth series

synthesis.procedure: Triethylamine (0.35 mL, 2.525 mmol) was added to a suspension of the sulfate salt of taci (0.091 g, 0.280 mmol) in methanol (30 mL) and the mixture was refluxed for 30 min. Lutetium nitrate hexahydrate (0.152 g, 0.421 mmol) was then added and stirring continued for 1 h. The resulting white powder (0.087 g) was collected by filtration. Slow diffusion of methanol into an aqueous solution of this powder afforded a few crystals suitable for X-ray crystallography.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: reflux then filtration; crystallization by slow methanol diffusion into aqueous solution
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: White powder (0.087 g) collected by filtration; slow diffusion of methanol into an aqueous solution of the powder gave a few X-ray quality crystals. Microanalysis of mixed crystal/powder samples was unsatisfactory due to heterogeneity.
synthesis.yield: 0.087 g of white powder (crystals: few, yield not quantified)
